## Streamline AI Physics Model Training and Deployment with Auto Tune


Rachel Fu


September 17, 2026


Simplify surrogate model development with AI Physics Auto Tune, coming soon to Rescale. Set a search duration and let AutoTune explore hyperparameter configurations in parallel, remove weak candidates early, fully train the strongest options, and select the best model across four production-ready architectures, without requiring deep AI/ML expertise.
